product_one_liner.value: D·engage is a customer experience data and marketing automation platform for brands that unifies customer data and orchestrates personalized, omnichannel customer journeys across channels such as email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as unifying customer data and enabling omnichannel personalization and automation.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Core, Pro, and Enterprise packages, although it does not show numerical prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified on D·engage customer-story pages.

employee_band.notes: The About page states 170+ employees, placing the company in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: The LinkedIn company profile identifies London as headquarters and gives the London office address.

founded_year.notes: The company profile states it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product updates, marketing and thought-leadership content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts on product implementation or technical architecture.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Base and developer reference contain multiple guides, product documentation, and API/SDK materials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board lists a Software Engineering Intern opening, but no AI/ML/data-science-titled role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public developer documentation, AI/product materials, blog, and Trust Center FAQ; found no public statement identifying a third-party AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company says it completed a SOC 2 Type II examination as of February 10, 2026. No other listed certification is included here.

last_funding.notes: The announcement dated September 3, 2025 confirms a strategic investment but does not disclose a funding amount. amount_usd is 0 as a placeholder for the undisclosed amount, not a claim that the round raised zero dollars.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 investment announcement falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers board lists a Software Engineering Intern opening and no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index and a recent product-update post are readable, but the launch-type post does not expose a publication date in the available page content, so whether it falls after May 9, 2026 cannot be established reliably.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The careers page has no full leadership roster, and no verifiable dated C-level or VP join/departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both systems are named in public Dengage integration documentation.
